report:
## Verdict: REJECT (a diff-added changeset line contradicts the skill body the same change ships)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #1834: a run cannot execute a bundled helper its own PR introduces - criteria from the /prflow:implement workpad; scope unchanged. The shipped skills/implement/SKILL.md bullet satisfies every acceptance criterion (unreachable on the cloud implement tier; two mechanisms - version-pinned vendoring rc-127/stale and trigger-time grant resolution silent denial; route to the existing deferral/Blocked path; forbid the workaround family by name; treat absent/stale/denied identically; two-denials rule preserved for every other shape; local tier unchanged) - and arguably exceeds them by detecting the case up front from the branch delta rather than on a failed invocation. The defect is confined to the two files that DESCRIBE the rule.

Prompt-surface edit routing evidence gate: DISCHARGED - the issue #1834 workpad carries Writing-skills evidence: markers for skills/implement/SKILL.md with all four dispositions explicitly recorded (skill-loaded=yes, guidance-applied=yes, pressure-scenario=no, micro-tests=yes/no across passes).

## Diff Classification
small_diff=true, config_only=true, has_new_types=false, engine_self_modifying=true (skills/implement/SKILL.md matches skills/**), detect_all_audit=false. engine_self_modifying overrides checklist behavior to run the full Phase 1+2 checklist (checklist_skipped=null); over a prose-only diff the checklist's sole verifiable claim is the doc-vs-skill-body accuracy the Phase 3 agents already resolved.

## Code Review Findings

### 🟠 Important / Major
1. .changeset/issue-1834-introduced-helper-unreachable.md line 12 says the run routes the dependent step to the deferral/Blocked path "on the first failed invocation", which is false against the shipped skills/implement/SKILL.md bullet the same change adds - the skill body routes up front from the branch delta, "not only on a failed invocation", because a modified helper runs stale at rc-0 and never fails. (raised by 4/4 agents) [self-contradicting-diff carve-out: .changeset/issue-1834-introduced-helper-unreachable.md] -- changeset prose ships into CHANGELOG.md (consumer-facing release note), so Phase 4.1.5 does not cap it; non-demotable REJECT.

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor
1. docs/internal/implement-skill.md (~lines 896-901) describes the skill-body rule as firing "on that helper's first failed invocation", contradicting the shipped up-front branch-delta rule and steering a future maintainer back toward the modified-helper silent failure. (raised by 4/4 agents) [behavior-inert prose cap: docs/internal is pruned from the vendor slice (not shipped) and no tool reads it for behavior - both limbs hold, capped from Important/Critical to Suggestion; still a real falsehood to fix alongside the changeset.]
2. skills/implement/SKILL.md new bullet: the four-item workaround enumeration exceeds the shipped-prose cost budget; trim to the directive plus one example. (raised by 1/4 agents)
3. skills/implement/SKILL.md new bullet: absent/stale/denied all attributed to post-merge timing could mask a genuine branch-introduced helper bug as a timing deferral; bounded by branch-delta scoping and the recorded deferral path. (raised by 1/4 agents)

## Verdict Criteria
- Self-contradicting-diff carve-out (threshold-independent, non-demotable): the changeset falsehood -> REJECT.
- Phase 4.1.5 behavior-inert prose cap applied to the docs/internal falsehood (both inertness limbs hold) -> capped at Suggestion, does not drive REJECT at the default critical threshold.
- over-grade annotation: 1 finding capped by the behavior-inert prose cap (docs/internal/implement-skill.md).
- truthfulness sweep: promoted/confirmed the changeset falsehood into the carve-out.
- intra-diff contradiction scan: the changeset/docs 'first failed invocation' framing contradicts the skill body's 'not only on a failed invocation' - same-symbol contradiction, filed.

The fix is two one-line prose edits (changeset + docs/internal) to match the shipped skill body's up-front branch-delta framing; the two minor suggestions are optional. No change to shipped runtime behavior is needed.
